text:
Elaine: Heads-up — I'm opening a tiny PR that consolidates the surge handling playbook for 429s/timeouts into a single 'slimline' page. It will include one canonical SDK snippet + runbook steps. Need quick review.
Miguel: sending link when ready?
Elaine: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492 (draft)
Anna: skimmed. Can we make the SDK snippet show both JS and Python with the retry-header example? Most callers use JS.
Jen: +1 to both. Also need explicit guidance for context-limit fallbacks — example: trim system messages first then user.
Sam: For trimming: include short snippet using our context-trim util:```js
const trimmed = trimContext(messages, {preserve: ['system','recent']});
await client.generate({model: 'redwood-1', input: trimmed});
```
Ryan: add note about choosing fallback model variant (e.g. redwood-1-8k -> redwood-1-4k) and graceful degradation of function calls.
Anna: Also mention that for 429 surge, we prefer exponential backoff with capped jitter and then route to fallback model after N attempts. Example backoff: 100ms * 2^n + rand(0,100)
Miguel: Can we include a tiny test harness? a curl reproducer + expected 429 handling in SDKs.
Elaine: Good. I'll add curl example and a short test script. Who can quick-UX review the phrasing? I want it short and prescriptive.
Sam: I can review tomorrow morning.
Jen: I'll run linter/links check — there are a few old links to 'err-ref' that should be updated to /troubleshooting/429
docs-bot: Link checker: 2 broken links detected in draft PR. See https://ci.redwood/doc-lk/492
Elaine: I'll fix links tonight. Miguel can you add the python snippet? Keep it minimal.
Miguel: On it. Will use requests + our SDK wrapper example.
Ryan: Minor suggestion: add a one-line table mapping signal -> action (429->backoff+retry, timeout->trim & retry once, context full->trim+fallback-model)
Elaine: Yes. I'll add table. If no blockers let's merge by EOD Thurs.
Anna: LGTM for content outline. Small wording ask: change 'retry forever' -> 'retry up to 3x with backoff'
Elaine: noted.
Jen: Link update done. docs-bot re-run pls.
docs-bot: Link checker: all links valid.
Elaine: Thanks team — PR updated with snippets and a one-page 'slimline' playbook. Merging after Sam + Miguel reviews. :thumbsup:
Sam: reviewing now.
Miguel: quick pass done, nit on python imports.
Sam: Approved. Great concise guide.
Elaine: merged. Thanks!
